exemplar_rules.cross_corpus: 22 of 41 few-shot exemplars (and the retrieval index and synthesis anchors) include HLQC sessions that are AnnoMI 15/21/44/53 and CASAA Emmy: apply the AnnoMI/CASAA exclusions to ANY model that saw HLQC gold by training, prompt exemplars, retrieval or synthetic data
exemplar_rules.draws: prompted arms use >= 3 exemplar draws (different selection seeds) and report mean +- sd; the exemplar draw is a variance source like the training seed
exemplar_rules.same_corpus_scoring: when scoring on the corpus the exemplars come from (HLQC CV, teacher screens), drop the exemplar SESSIONS from scoring (exemplars carry 5 context volleys), or draw exemplars from other folds
exemplar_rules.source: exemplars come only from the training side of the split: HLQC gold under misc_main; under pooled CV, HLQC gold by default (keeps the exemplar factor constant across protocols), the fold's training MIV sessions only as an explicit, labelled arm; never a test session

notes: Unchanged from all prior experiments. CASAA sessions duplicating any HLQC session are excluded.

variance_rules.fold_draw: for k-fold designs, re-draw the fold assignment with each training seed (seed-tied) or use leave-one-session-out, so no result rests on one fold assignment
variance_rules.intervals: 95% CI from resampling sessions (clusters), on top of the across-seed spread
variance_rules.pairing: compare arms at the same seed and the same folds; report the mean of paired differences
variance_rules.single_split: do not report a single random train/test split as a headline: use the grouped k-fold CV
variance_rules.training_seeds: at least 3 matched seeds (42, 1, 2) for any claimed difference; one seed = exploratory only
